run_migrate_checkpoint_cli: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI tool to convert an OCP checkpoint to FM release format with --checkpoint-in and --checkpoint-out
run_migrate_checkpoint_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --add-stress to automatically add stress tasks for datasets missing them
run_migrate_checkpoint_remove_static: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --no-remove-static-keys to preserve static keys like expand_index and offset in state dicts
call_migrate_checkpoint_function: call the migrate_checkpoint function to load a checkpoint, update module imports, and optionally add stress tasks
call_generate_stress_task_config: call generate_stress_task_config to create a stress task configuration dict with DDPMTLoss and MAELoss for a given dataset
